name: Atle Haga
career_history: Vice President Strategy & Development at STACK Infrastructure, 4/2025 to present; Member Board of Directors at CTS Nordics AS, 9/2023 to 4/2025; Member of The Board and Co-Founder at Norwegian Data Center Industry, 6/2021 to present; Head Commercial Advisor at Statkraft, 1/2019 to 4/2025; Program Director at Statkraft AS, 8/2014 to 12/2018; Project manager at Stavernfestivalen, 7/2008 to 7/2015; Managing Director at Energyinfo AS, 9/2006 to 8/2014; Consultant at Elkem BKK Fjordkraft Landsvirkjun and others, 1/2006 to 10/2011; Vice Chairman at Nordic Association of Electricity Traders, 4/2005 to 5/2008; Senior Power Trader at Statkraft, 9/2002 to 9/2006; Managing Director at Aquila Energy Nordic, 8/1999 to 8/2002; Portfolio Manager at Interkraft Energi AS, 1/1996 to 8/1999; Senior Currency Trader at Union Bank of Norway Luxembourg, 3/1994 to 1/1996; Currency trader at Union Bank of Norway, 1/1987 to 2/1994
